featured_reviews.review_text:
I've had the pleasure of joining Let's Go Outdoors for two Flamingo Walks and one Tree Plantation Drive, and each experience has been nothing short of fantastic.

The flamingo drive was so much fun. Although flamingos were the highlight, we also got to see so many other birds and their local names as well. It was very informative.

The tree plantation at yusuf mehrally was so memorable. We also went for a short nature trail and although it was my first time trekking, the team didnt make me feel so. The team was extremely encouraging and supportive! It was one of the most rewarding experiences and im so grateful to lets go outdoors team for giving me that opportunity!

Lets go outdoors is the perfect choice for true nature enthusiasts 😊

featured_reviews.name: Prerana Shetty
featured_reviews.review_text: I took this trip with my family and it was a beautiful experience. We had an awesome guide to tell us about the flora and fauna as he took us around the flamingo sanctuary. The view was amazing and we got to learn a lot.

featured_reviews.name: Aditya Soman
featured_reviews.review_text:
I have been with the group thrice so far. 2 walks and one trip. Have had the best experience everytime.
My recent trip was to Spiti valley.
First things first , the group is eco conscious. This is one of the most important factors behind my decision to go on trips with them.
The less frequented places are chosen , the arrangements are mind blowing. You will get to experience and do lot of your Firsts.
During my trip to Spiti , right from the initial stage I was quite amazed in the way things were carried out. We were accompanied by Sandesh on this trip. He is a very jovial person and in-depth information of a lot of things. At one moment you are a foodie , the next you are getting some information about the flora and fauna !
Looking forward to my next outing with these guys.

Cheers 🤘🏻

featured_reviews.name: Goretti Yadav
featured_reviews.review_text: Being my first trek at the age of 50 I was not sure if I should go ahead with it, but Mr. Sandesh Lad assured that I would be fine and trek trained Ms. Tejasvi would take good care of us. His assuring words turned truth when Mr. Chandrakant (Pappu) and Ms. Tejasvi ensured that I was comfortable through the Trek as I had to take longer breaks because of steep stone paths and some patches of steep climb. I am glad I trusted Mr. Lad as the view up there was breath taking, fresh air and night halt in one of the ancient caves was amazing. The group was well looked after and the highlight was having traditional local dinner, breakfast and lunch in mud houses sitting on cowdung floors in the houses of locals. It was the best experience for me and I look forward to many more such experiences with " Let's go Outdoors". Very economical for the pocket too. Thank you Mr. Lad, Ms. Tejasvi and Mr. Chandrakant (Mr. Pappu).

featured_reviews.name: Ayushi Kanodia
featured_reviews.review_text:
Our experience with them on our weekend trip to Anjarle was fantastic. We had a great time exploring a new place and making new friends.

The highlight of our trip was watching the turtles, which was a unique and memorable experience. Additionally, the food was amazing, as we had the opportunity to try delicious Maharashtrian cuisine.

featured_reviews.name: Rachana Thakar
featured_reviews.review_text:
HEAVEN FOR REAL #Letsgo

14/12/2017-17/12/2017
The best decision of joining the Digital Detoxification trip by Let’s Go Outdoors
I never knew that such a beautiful world exists until I decided to go for digital detox with let's go and explored the mesmerizing beauties of nature.
My first ever trip.
Uttarakhand,Jim Corbett

Meeting a group of unknown people who are no more unknown to me.
Traveling on beautiful roads of Delhi to Uttarakhand.
Reaching Jim Corbett and then walking towards Eco Resort for 45mins brought butterflies in my stomach of every surprise on the way. Crossing the river on a small raft made me happy like a kid.
Cool breeze hitting my face,sound of the river and birds made me feel so close to the nature. There I see the beautiful place where we will stay in the middle  of the forest welcoming me with wide open arms to experience the most amazing next 2days of my life.
Never thought mornings can be so beautiful in the forests and mountains where all you see is loving nature.
The lovely staff of the resort made us extremely happy by the service provided. The yummiest and healthy food they served and how can I forget the smiles on their faces after seeing us happy.
The experience of star gazing, bird watching, spotting animals like barking deer, sambar, lungurs, brown fish owl, vultures and many more. Sitting near the river side made me realise we are so unaware about our beautiful places and nature in our country. But not any more. I promised myself sitting near the river that I want to see more, learn more and LIVE MORE.
Today this is a ‘SUPER HAPPY ME’ after realising that we really must leave our phones and all the gadgets aside and live and enjoy the beautiful experiences, which cannot be captured by any camera of this world. It can only be felt.
In the end I am so grateful to Sandesh for taking me to such a beautiful place.
Memories for life☺

name: Vastukathaa Heritage Trails
description: Vastukathaa (वास्तुकथा) is a heritage initiative dedicated to exploring, documenting, and sharing the stories behind India's architectural legacy. It focuses on temple architecture, rock-cut caves, sculptures, inscriptions, forts, and historical monuments through research, photography, and storytelling. By combining history, archaeology, art, and culture, Vastukathaa aims to make heritage accessible and engaging for modern audiences. The initiative seeks to preserve traditional knowledge, inspire appreciation for India's rich past, and promote heritage conservation. Vastukathaa believes that every monument is more than a structure—it is a living story that connects people to their history, identity, and cultural roots.

An Unforgettable and Eye Opening Tour with the Amazing Pooja!

Our tour of Dharavi with Magical Mumbai Tour was one of the absolute highlights of our time in the city, and it was made truly special by our fantastic guide, Pooja.
From the very beginning, Pooja was warm, knowledgeable, and incredibly passionate. She didn't just show us the sights; she shared stories and introduced us to the vibrant community spirit that makes Dharavi so unique. Her personal connection to the area allowed for an authentic and respectful experience that completely shattered our preconceptions. We learned so much about the recycling businesses, the local industries, and the daily lives of the resilient and hardworking people who live there.
If you are thinking about taking this tour, we cannot recommend it enough. For the best possible experience, you MUST ask for Pooja. Her insight, professionalism, and wonderful personality are what made this a five-star, truly unforgettable tour!

Walking tours expose many residents and visitors to the structures.

Had such a beautiful experience on the Alibaug trip with Hiker Wolf — everything was so smooth, well-managed and thoughtfully planned. From the travel to the stay to every little detail in between, it genuinely felt effortless.
A special shoutout to our trip leader, who truly made the journey even more memorable. They made sure everyone felt included, kept the energy alive with fun games, and most importantly, looked after everyone’s safety and comfort throughout the trip. You could really feel the care and responsibility behind the scenes.
What I loved most was the vibe — strangers turning into friends, lots of laughter, meaningful conversations, and moments that felt like little core memories 🌅✨
If you’re someone who wants to travel, unwind, and still feel completely taken care of, Hiker Wolf is the way to go. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: juli kumari
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had an amazing first trip with Tiger Wolf! We covered two Jyotirlingas along with the Shirdi Sai Baba Temple and the Shani Shingnapur Temple.

A special thanks to our trek leader Nikhil, who managed everything so smoothly. His coordination was excellent—he ensured we reached every temple on time without any hassle and also made sure everyone was safely dropped at their locations.

The trip was well-organized, perfectly timed, and completely stress-free. Overall, a great experience—looking forward to traveling with Tiger Wolf again!

featured_reviews.name: LeLe
featured_reviews.review_text: Highly recommend this outstanding tour! Friends of mine did a food tour with Arpan and liked it so much they booked a walking tour with him for the next day and asked me to join. Arpan took us to interesting places, some of which you wouldn't find in a tour guide and he knew a lot to tell about them, you get to meet locals and hardly see any other tourists. Arpan is super funny and smart, he speaks excellent English and has very reasonable prices for his tours. If I come back to Mumbai I'll definitely do a tour with him again.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much Leon for the review. Looking forward to host you again.

featured_reviews.name: Sas Mac
featured_reviews.review_text:
I went to Mumbai as a solo female traveller in May 2019 with 2 nights booked not knowing anyone or much about the city. I saw Bombay walks advertised at my hostel and thought I would check it out for the evening to introduce me to the city. I ended up staying and extra night and booking a tour with Arpan everyday as I had so much fun and made my way around the city like a local on the trains, tuk tuks and walking. I ate street food and was shown the history of Mumbai. Arpan was fun, respectable and knowledgable about Mumbai and India. He gave me help with the rest of my trip, recomending Udaipur and booking my flights for my. He also has great insite into hostels throughout the country!

Great guy, couldn't recommend him more
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Sas for a lovely review. :)

featured_reviews.name: Sam Shapiro
featured_reviews.review_text: Arpan was great- he was very knowledgeable about the history of India and of the places he took us. He began by providing us with context for everywhere we were going to go that day, showing us on a map what the route would look like and why he chose the places he was taking us to. Each place he took us was very interesting and, as promised, slightly different than what you may find from a more generic tour. He was great at answering questions, and ended the tour with a discussion with the group about what it’s like to grow up in India.

featured_reviews.name: Derishta Pillay
featured_reviews.review_text:
At the outset I must say that neither myself nor my husband are huge fans of the usual guided walking tours mainly because we hate being taken to cliched and crowded tourist hotspots, listening to facts straight from the Wikipedia page and jostling for space with other tourists just to return sunburned and underwhelmed. In addition we'd already spent a hectic 5 weeks in India - we were tired, grumpy, waiting to fly back home and not at all looking forward to our last 4 days in Mumbai at all. So basically when our travel companions insisted we book a tour - the scene was set for disaster...
'Bombay Walks' single handedly turned this around and Mumbai actually turned out to be the highlight of our trip! (Nope this is not a sponsored review 😂)

The tour: Arpan's tour extends to the days before and after the actual tour as he offers valuable advice about where to stay/eat/party/shop etc. He speaks perfect English, is pleasant and very easy to communicate with. His passion and love for the city is infectious and you will end his tour enthralled, overwhelmed and completely charmed by Mumbai and it's people - vowing to come back and dig deeper, spend longer and see more. The city tour covers many facets of the city - traveling to hidden gems and local landmarks across the length and breadth of Mumbai. You get to see and experience aspects of Mumbai that you'd never be able to do alone with a guide book or google maps - like traveling on local trains and walking through Worli fishing village and stopping by at small off-the-beaten path temples and churches.

The guide: Arpan is reliable, trustworthy and comes well prepared for the type of group. His talking style is light-hearted and easy going but still knowledgeable and always engaging. He's the type of guide that can tell you interesting facts about the history, architecture and politics of a place but also where to get the best coconut water along the way and which public toilets are ok to use.
We only met Arpan in person on the day of the tour and although we were constantly bombarded with sights, sounds and smells (it is Mumbai after all) - it never once felt like we were just being dragged from point to point whilst he rattled off information but rather that we were spending the day walking around with an old friend.

Target travelers: We're fairly well travelled and yet this is the first time we've ever bothered to leave a tour review - on any platform - I think that in itself indicates how highly we recommend this tour.
This is really a 'must do' in Mumbai.
It's so good we would do this tour again even if it were to cover the exact route we already took. The walking wasn't particular strenuous so it's recommended for any age group it should also be noted that we found that     Arpan was discreetly always conscious of where the group members were and their safety and constantly aware of our surroundings and the locals around us - on that note I would recommend this tour even if you're a single female traveling alone.

When to do it: Try and do this tour on your first full day in Mumbai because it's also a great way to orientate yourself around the city and plan the rest of your time there.

That city that everyone talks about - that's all of India's many faces and layers in one, that accepts everyone, that's everyone's home - regardless of language, religion or creed - Mumbai is THAT city and you'd be crazy if you miss the opportunity to let a born-and-bred local guide you around...
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Derishta for a 5 star rating and such a lovely review. :)

featured_reviews.name: Moni K.
featured_reviews.review_text: Thanks to Bombay Walks Mumbay became the highlight of my India trip! Arpan took me to hidden places to give me an authentic insight to the city and its lifestyle and it was just amazing. I experienced street food, local markets and cozy bars with him. As a female solo traveller i never felt unsafe during my time with Arpan. He is such a perfect guide who speaks clear english and takes care of u all of the time. Really highly recommendable, also for female travellers!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you Monika. Glad that you had fun in Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Tonya Lenox
featured_reviews.review_text:
Simply amazing. It was our last tour of our trip but easily our favorite one!  I wish he could’ve done all our tours through India! And such a good price.
He was our only tour guide who did not push us to purchase things or leave a review. He cared more about us truly having a good experience and understanding of his country.
He had a lot of knowledge of so many different aspects of not only the locations he showed us but also could answer a lot of questions we had about India in general as well. He was timely, communicated easily and most importantly had a great mix of fun and truth on the tour. Highly recommend!

featured_reviews.name: sheena patel
featured_reviews.review_text:
Mumbai, it’s a city I’ve ‘visited’ many times however I wouldn’t say I had experienced the localities until I booked myself on the fabulous walking tour with Arpan. Bombay walks allowed tourists to experience the pockets of the city in detail and depth.

Arpan is extremely knowledgable about the various different neighbourhoods of mumbai. The tour takes you through various areas of the crazy city. He will point out all the landmarks, highlights and he definitely knows some of mumbai’s best hidden coffee spots😉.

You can ask him a million questions and he will patiently give you all the answers.
Leaving you in awe of how Mumbai comes together chaotically.

The tour had been designed to give tourists like myself a taster of this metro. I would highly recommend it! Our bilingual Arpan can share his stories in English, Hindi, Marathi and Marwari :)

I look forward to returning to Mumbai soon  and participating in many other walks!
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Thank you so much Sheena for your review.

featured_reviews.name: Baker Mags
featured_reviews.review_text:
Wonderful experience!

Arpan is friendly and full of knowledge.
Would have not been able to experience the beautiful churches, streets, food and art of Bandra without his support. One should definately opt for this walking tour.

Highly recommended.

All the best!
-Megha

featured_reviews.name: Alex Bukstein
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an incredible three-day tour in Mumbai with Sajid as our guide and Dipak as our driver, and I couldn’t recommend them more highly! Sajid was incredibly knowledgeable, taking us everywhere from the vibrant city center to the fascinating Elphanta Caves, and even giving us a glimpse into Bollywood and the Slums. His passion for sharing the culture, history, and unique aspects of Mumbai truly enhanced the experience.

Dipak was a fantastic driver, navigating the busy streets with ease and ensuring we were always comfortable and safe. Both Sajid and Dipak were not only professional but also kind, patient, and attentive to every detail. They made us feel welcome and taken care of every step of the way.

If you’re visiting Mumbai and want a memorable, well-rounded tour, this team is absolutely the best choice. Thank you for an unforgettable experience!

featured_reviews.name: Ire C.
featured_reviews.review_text: We did the tour of the slums with Rehana and it was extremely interesting, she told us a lot about what is done and how people leave there. It is really recommended to take a tour with this travel agency! It is a must do if you visit Mumbai.

featured_reviews.name: Samuele Premi
featured_reviews.review_text: Sajid was amazing and showed everything inside the largest slum in Asia. He is very knowledgeable because he was born there, he is nice and answers every kind of question you might have. I will do other tours with him!
